evals.prompt: Prepare the upload for https://tak.gov/user_builds, but this workstation has no TPP credentials or local.properties.
evals.expected: Builds the source ZIP without --verify-build, uploads only that ZIP after explicit authorization, excludes local.properties and signing material, and does not treat missing artifacts.tak.gov credentials as a blocker.

evals.prompt: Stage this completed TPP response for release.
evals.expected: Uses dist, verifies source/version/signer, and does not expose the raw response filename.

evals.prompt: Move the published v1.4.2 tag to include a docs fix.
evals.expected: Refuses tag mutation and recommends a new version.
